name: boundroom
description: Drive a repository's synced Boundroom supervisor: see what is next, run exactly one slice, evaluate a handoff, and sync a consumer through a pull request.

claude_profile.title: Claude runner profile
claude_profile.description: parent, bounded, edits, unbounded or custom. Empty uses the supervisor's default, bounded.

claude_profile_ceiling.title: Claude runner ceiling
claude_profile_ceiling.description: bounded, edits or unbounded: the most a runner may get. Empty uses the supervisor's default, edits, or unbounded on a machine declared isolated.

telemetry.title: Telemetry mode
telemetry.description: off, file or otlp. Empty means off: telemetry is never on unless you set a mode and a destination.

telemetry_capture.title: Telemetry capture
telemetry_capture.description: metadata or content. Empty means metadata.

telemetry_runner.title: Runner telemetry
telemetry_runner.description: off, metadata or content. Empty means off.
